entities.name: Jürgen Rohwer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jürgen Rohwer was a German military historian and professor of history at the University of Stuttgart. Rohwer wrote more than 400 books and essays on World War II naval history and military intelligence, which gained him worldwide recognition as a prominent historian and a leading authority on U-boats.

entities.name: Jürgen Rohwer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jürgen Rohwer was a German military historian and professor of history at the University of Stuttgart. Rohwer wrote more than 400 books and essays on World War II naval history and military intelligence, which gained him worldwide recognition as a prominent historian and a leading authority on U-boats.
